extracted.name: Jen's Fresh and Spicy Salsa
extracted.description: This spicy salsa recipe is easy to make in a blender with fresh tomatoes, green onions, jalapeños, lime, and cilantro for a refreshing but fiery dip.
instruction_lines: Pulse tomatoes, green onions, jalapeño peppers, and cilantro in a blender or food processor to desired consistency. Transfer to a serving bowl. Mix in lime juice, hot pepper sauce, black pepper, garlic powder, and salt until well combined.
